headline: Weak sentiment overshadows strong performance

highlights: Its hospitals division outperformed our expectation (+18.6% YoY) on the back of a surge in patient volumes and rise in ARPP.
In H1FY27, it added 300 beds (~6% bed capacity), which boosted revenue growth without hurting its margins (ex-ESOP hospital margins surged 39bps YoY).
Management has devised a bed-expansion plan, which ensures sufficient capacity (1,000–1,100 beds over FY26–29) to maintain this growth momentum.
Concerns related to ESOP cost and a regulatory impact on margins are overblown.
valuation: Valuation and risks Fortis Q2FY27 reflected disciplined execution across both of its verticals.
The stock currently trades at EV/EBITDA of 24.1x FY27E and 19.1x FY28E.
We maintain BUY with an unchanged target price of INR 1,075, based on FY28E SoTP- based valuation, valuing hospitals/diagnostics business at 27x/24x FY28E EV/EBITDA (unchanged).
